answer: Ask each agent to answer occasional questions that require knowing its own earlier work, such as quoting the reasoning behind a grade it gave weeks ago. A real agent that keeps its own history can answer easily. A farm that spins up keys on demand, or shares one script among many, cannot keep each key history straight, so its answers contradict or match each other. Every key must keep its own atlas of past work; a sybil ring trying to fake that is like a vine draped over many trees, while an honest agent grows like a single cedar.
